nodes.title: Note: OpenRouter API key
widgets_values:
## Paste an OpenRouter key before you run this

The Auto Prompt group takes your one-line idea and writes the full H3 prompt for you. It calls OpenRouter to do that, so it needs a key. Leave the box empty and no prompt gets written, which means nothing generates.

1. Get a key at https://openrouter.ai/keys
2. Paste it into the OpenRouter API Key box

Every so often OpenRouter rejects a prompt. Reword the idea and run it again.
